title: finding(skills): `guides/schema-expressions.md` says the native `{ field, operator, value }` rule "still works" for kanban conditional formatting, which `object-kanban` refuses by name once PR #11532 lands
body:
Filing-gate category: ① a documentation defect, class (b): a governed guide contradicts a declared contract.

- **`reach:`**
  - At PR #11532's head `e423e415` (objectui#11522, ACCEPTED by this seat and entering the merge queue), `object-kanban`'s `conditionalFormatting` refuses the native rule `{ field, operator, value, backgroundColor, borderColor }` by name on `ObjectKanbanSchema`, `safeValidateSchema` and `StrictAnyComponentSchema`. The refusal says the rule is retired and gives the respelling as `{ condition, style }`. This is from the dev's `refusal_messages` in report `5964832134`, confirmed in the at-tier record `5964941644` ① 2.
  - `skills/objectui/guides/schema-expressions.md` (read at objectui `main` `06634afe`), section "CEL predicates over a row record" (line 316), opens with "Conditional formatting on a list/grid/kanban, …". Its bullet at lines 332-337 says:

    > The native `{ field, operator, value }` form … and the `{ expression: "${…}" }` template form still work and are rewritten to CEL transparently.

  - Once PR #11532 lands, that is false for `object-kanban` authoring. An author or AI that follows the guide writes a kanban rule that the validator refuses. It is still true of the shared evaluator and of grid and list-view rules (objectui#11533 tracks those).
- **Why not fixed in PR #11532:** `skills/**` is a governed surface, and objectui#11522 was ungoverned (Governed Surface Queue Guard green on its head). The contract record escalated this to the governed-surface queue (③ (c)).
- **Source:** the os-dev report on objectui#11522 (`out_of_scope_findings[2]`) and the at-tier records `5964941644` / `5965014904` on PR #11532.
- Filed by the `domain:spec @ objectui` seat (objectui#10217, `session_01XvhGmGAP79ZB8swnkapxPC`). ⛔ Not graded here.

## Direction (for triage, not a ruling)

The guide states what each surface accepts: `object-kanban` takes `{ condition, style }` only (objectui#11522), and grid and list-view rules keep the legacy forms until objectui#11533 is decided. Sequence the fix after PR #11532 lands. Governed-surface route: draft PR, maintainer approval.

## Dedupe

The 1,000 most recently updated objectui issues and PRs, open and closed, back to 2026-09-25 (REST, grepped locally 2026-10-03):
- `schema-expressions`: 17 hits. Every one is closed and concerns other guide statements (objectui#11256, #11414, #11419, #11418, #11404 and others), or is a seat post. None concerns the native-rule bullet.
